rationale:
Evidence. Iteration 5 moved the sensor row from y = 0.05 to y = 0.02 with everything else as iteration 4. Oval and s-bend were identical to iteration 4 to four decimals (progress 0.115 and 0.040, max_error 0.0611 to 0.0614), so the move had no effect there. Slalom got worse: progress fell from 0.105 to 0.035, score fell from 43.2 to 14.9, and line loss went from 1 to 0 with max_error 0.0609. The move cost slalom progress and bought nothing on the other tracks, so y = 0.02 is rejected. Across iterations 0 to 5, max_error stays pinned at 0.061 to 0.063 whatever changed (kp, kd, ki, sensor size, span, speed, y). The best raced score is still iteration 1 (38.61). Iteration 4 (y = 0.05, base_speed 1.1, wide span) is the best geometry and speed setting so far at 36.43.

Change. I return the sensor row to y = 0.05 and keep the wide span (x = -0.07 to 0.07 m, 16 mm footprint) and base_speed 1.1, which restores the iteration-4 configuration. I then make one controller change: kd from 0.15 to 0.30. kd has never been raised above 0.15, and the approved feedback names it as the next lever if max_error stays near 0.061. I am reverting y rather than keeping it at 0.02 as the approved feedback suggested, because iteration 5 showed y = 0.02 hurts slalom progress without helping any track. Everything else is held at iteration-4 values (kp 2.0, ki 0.4, line_loss last_direction), so the race isolates kd against iteration 4.

Expected result. A stronger damping term should reduce the early lateral overshoot at bend entry and at the start, so max_error should drop toward or below 0.06 on s-bend and slalom, and progress should rise above the iteration-4 values (0.040 s-bend, 0.105 slalom). Risk: kd amplifies sensor noise, so steering_oscillation (0.067 to 0.148 so far) may rise, and max_error may not change if the cause is the start transient.

Hypotheses. H1: kd = 0.3 is the missing damping, and max_error falls below 0.06. H2: max_error stays near 0.061 at kd = 0.3, which would point to the start condition or the motor mismatch rather than the feedback loop. In that case the next test is line_loss = search_right or search_left, or a speed reduction with more kd.

Measurements wanted: max_error and rms_error per track, line_loss_events, progress, completion, steering_oscillation and completion_time, so I can see whether kd changes the early transient on s-bend and slalom.
